headword: {銀行|ぎんこう}{振込|ふりこみ}

definitions.explanation: The transfer of money from one bank account to another, either at the same bank or between different banks.

examples.japanese: {銀行|ぎんこう}{振込|ふりこみ}でお{願|ねが}いします。
{家賃|やちん}は{毎月|まいつき}{銀行|ぎんこう}{振込|ふりこみ}で{支払|しはら}っている。
examples.english: I pay the rent by bank transfer every month.

examples.japanese: {銀行|ぎんこう}{振込|ふりこみ}の{手数料|てすうりょう}は{振込先|ふりこみさき}によって{異|こと}なります。
examples.english: Bank transfer fees vary depending on the destination account.

notes:
A compound of {銀行|ぎんこう} (bank) and {振込|ふりこみ} (transfer/deposit). Bank transfers remain one of the most common payment methods in Japan for rent, utility bills, online purchases, and business transactions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {銀行|ぎんこう}{振込|ふりこみ}で{支払|しはら}う: to pay by bank transfer
- {銀行|ぎんこう}{振込|ふりこみ}の{手数料|てすうりょう}: bank transfer fee
- {銀行|ぎんこう}{振込|ふりこみ}の{確認|かくにん}: confirmation of bank transfer
- {銀行|ぎんこう}{振込|ふりこみ}{明細|めいさい}: bank transfer statement

RELATED WORDS:
- {振込|ふりこみ}: transfer/deposit (the general term)
- {口座|こうざ}{振替|ふりかえ}: direct debit, automatic account transfer
- {送金|そうきん}: remittance, sending money (broader term that includes international transfers)
